rules.sentence: Identify patients with possible orbital solitary fibrous tumors based on their clinical presentation.
Differentiate orbital solitary fibrous tumors from other orbital masses based on imaging characteristics.
Orbital SFTs pose a diagnostic challenge; they are rare neoplasms that present similarly to other orbital lesions.
Orbital SFTs rarely metastasize and are treated with complete surgical excision.
Patients with an orbital SFT typically present with nonspecific symptoms characterized by slowly progressive, unilateral eyelid, eye, or periorbital swelling, proptosis, edema, or a palpable mass.
